notes.title: SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream Demo Version Released
notes.content:
[h3]The demo for SWORD ART ONLINE Fractured Daydream has been released![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3319640/

[h3]Play as select characters from the roster and try the Co-Op Quest and  Boss Raid! Challenge Illfang the Kobold Lord and The Skull Reaper together with other demo players!

Take a look at the System Trailer for more details on the game systems! [/h3]
[previewyoutube=2kRe0iaUDiM;full][/previewyoutube]
